targets.queryText: SELECT start_time/1000 as time, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'azm-fat-burn' THEN value END) as FatBurn, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'azm-cardio' THEN value END) as Cardio, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'azm-peak' THEN value END) as Peak FROM metrics WHERE metric_type IN ('azm-fat-burn', 'azm-cardio', 'azm-peak') AND user_id = (SELECT id FROM users LIMIT 1) GROUP BY start_time ORDER BY start_time

targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(start_time/1000, 'unixepoch') as start, exercise_type as type, display_name as name, ROUND((julianday(datetime(end_time/1000,'unixepoch')) - julianday(datetime(start_time/1000,'unixepoch'))) * 1440, 1) as duration_min, calories_kcal as kcal, ROUND(distance_mm / 1000000.0, 2) as distance_km, avg_heart_rate as avg_bpm FROM exercise_sessions WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users LIMIT 1) ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 50
